mandatory_submission_requirements.quote:
B. MANDATORY SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS 
1. 
Submission Form (Appendix B) 
Each quotation must include a Submission Form (Appendix B) completed and signed by an 
authorized representative of the respondent. 
2. 
Pricing (Appendix C) 
Each quotation must include pricing information that complies with the instructions contained in 
Pricing (Appendix C). Proponents are encouraged to view the proposed locations before 
submission of pricing. Use Bid Form attached as a separate document (Annex B). 
3. 
Other Mandatory Submission Requirements Evidence of Safety Program and 
Insurance 
Upon notice of intent to negotiate, the Proponent will be required to supply: 
A valid copy of a current WCB clearance letter with the executed contract and with each invoice 
submitted for payment. 
Provide evidence of an active safety program such as providing a valid copy of an Alberta 
Certificate of Recognition (COR or SECOR or other Industry Partner certificate) or other 
evidence of an active workplace safety program. 
A valid certificate of insurance with coverage not less than Two (2) Million dollars from an 
insurance company legally capable of carrying on business within the province of Alberta, names 
the Village as an additional insured with cross liability, and provides an minimum 30 days notice 
of any changes to the policy. 
Both WCB and Insurance documentation MUST indicate coverage for the type of work being 
requested in this competition and carried out in the resulting agreement.

evaluation_criteria.quote: RATED CRITERIA SCALE 0-5 WEIGHT Project Price - As per appendix C 35% Project Understanding/Approach/ Schedule 20% Team Members Qualifications & Expertise 30% Relevant Past Experience 15%

value.category: Project Price - As per appendix C

pricing_structure.quote: The Proponent submitting the lowest price shall receive the full point value available for the price score. All other Proponent pricing shall be divided into the lowest compliant price received in order to obtain the ratio. That ratio shall be used to determine the points to be allocated to the submission.
pricing_structure.value: Lowest compliant price receives full 35 points; all other pricing is divided by the lowest compliant price to obtain a ratio, which determines the points allocated. Pricing is worth 35 points of the total score. Submission format: Appendix C pricing table with lump sum prices for Implement PubWorks and update Data, Implement ArcGIS and update Data, and Develop Processes and Provide Training; ongoing maintenance and support billed per hour on an as needed basis. Rates in Canadian funds, inclusive of all applicable duties and taxes except GST itemized separately; all-inclusive rates including all labour, material, travel, insurance, delivery, installation, set-up, pre-delivery inspection, and other overhead costs. Pricing is submitted as part of the quotation (Appendix C), not separately from the technical proposal.

value.basis: not less than Two (2) Million dollars

vendor_experience_required.quote: Proponents must provide details on two (2) projects completed in the last five (5) to ten (10) years which are the most relevant and similar to the services.
vendor_experience_required.value: Two (2) relevant projects completed in the last five (5) to ten (10) years, similar in scope and size to the services; emphasis on high levels of experience working with municipalities on similar greenspace projects and complexity. Team members must demonstrate relevant expertise and capabilities; Professional Registrations may be included. No explicit minimum years of experience stated for the vendor overall; the rated criteria scale awards 1 point for minimum one year experience, 2 for two years, 3 for three-four years, 4 for more than five years, and 5 for more than ten years.

references_required.quote: Proponents must provide details on two (2) projects completed in the last five (5) to ten (10) years which are the most relevant and similar to the services. Proponents should note that the Village may contact the client to provide a reference on the experience listed (including amending scoring in the evaluation based on the client's feedback).
